tail:
Batch 19 is authored: the A page has 15 items and the B page has one example. I added four local prerequisites to the audited proposal inventory, recomputed item levels, completed the proof contracts and source coverage, and wrote 16 hash-valid Step 1 **draft-ready** records.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (59 steps, zero defects), focused dependency checking, rendering, content policy, proof contracts, coverage, source fetching (4/4 stamped), and manifest reconciliation. The batch’s 84 cross-batch edges also match its declared dependencies.

Run-wide issues remain for the owner:

- The dependency-level check reports 84 errors outside batch 19: 54 empty inventories and 30 stale labels. Batch 19 has no level errors.
- The legacy `precheck.mts` reports `untagged-steps` for 13 proof-bearing items because it checks only each numbered step’s opening line. The rendered proof-layout check passes all 59 steps.
- Run-wide cross-batch collection fails on malformed or missing carriers outside this pair. The batch-19 edges were reconciled directly against the manifests.
- Transitive supplier metadata reaches countable-choice/choice definitions through broad dependency paths. I documented why the proof branches used here are choice-free and recorded that graph over-approximation for owner review.

The source retrieval and mathematical decisions are recorded in the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-19.notes.md>), with the [manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-19.pages.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-19.proof-contracts.json>), [coverage](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-19.coverage.json>), and [cross-batch evidence](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-19.cross-batch-dependencies.json>). The readiness records are authoring evidence, not independent proof approval.
